aviation_incidents.headline: 聯合航空機組拒絕穿越雷雨航路，改飛替代航線
aviation_incidents.summary: 聯合航空一架波音737-700原定11月6日星期五執行471號班機，由聖安東尼奧飛往華盛頓杜勒斯。班機推出並滑行時，機組對航管提出的航路提出質疑，指出該航路將穿越雷雨最劇烈的區域。一段由Aviation MP4分享的錄音顯示，機長表示將與聯合航空簽派聯繫，機組拒絕穿越最多可能持續四小時的惡劣天氣，認為這對機組是嚴苛考驗，也會影響乘客舒適度。報導指出，這起事件據信發生在11月6日，但Simple Flying表示尚未證實。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: United pilots refuse ATC routing through severe thunderstorm and fly alternative route
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A United Airlines Boeing 737-700 was scheduled to operate flight 471 from San Antonio to Washington Dulles (IAD) on Friday, November 6. After pushing back and while taxiing, the crew questioned the routing proposed by air traffic control, which would have taken the aircraft through the worst part of a severe thunderstorm. A recording shared by Aviation MP4 shows the pilot saying he would speak with United dispatch, and the crew refusing to fly through what would have been up to four hours of challenging weather, which they said would be demanding for the crew and uncomfortable for passengers. The report says the incident is believed to have taken place on November 6, but Simple Flying notes this has not been confirmed.

taiwan_aviation.headline: F-16V block70第2批3架飛抵台東，空軍推進接裝訓練逐步達初始戰力
taiwan_aviation.summary: 空軍司令部8日表示，台灣向美採購的F-16V（block70）戰機繼10月2日首批2架飛返後，第2批3架戰機編號6729、6731、6732接續於上午順利飛抵台東志航基地，後續將依計畫推展部隊接裝訓練，逐步達成初始作戰能力。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Second batch of three Taiwan F-16V Block 70 fighters arrives in Taitung
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's Air Force Command said on November 8 that the second batch of three F-16V (Block 70) fighters purchased from the United States, serials 6729, 6731 and 6732, arrived at Chihhang Air Base in Taitung on the morning of November 8, following the first batch of two aircraft that returned on October 2. The Air Force said it will proceed with unit conversion training as planned, working toward initial operational capability.

international_aviation.headline: 加航以A321XLR取代部分787航班：11條航線調整、騰出的787轉飛長程新航點
international_aviation.summary: 加拿大航空表示，787將在未來數月撤出11條航線，包括卡加利—倫敦、渥太華—倫敦、蒙特婁—土魯斯、蒙特婁—波爾圖、蒙特婁—哥本哈根、蒙特婁—巴黎、蒙特婁—愛丁堡、蒙特婁—卡薩布蘭卡、蒙特婁—柏林、多倫多—蘇黎世與多倫多—威尼斯；其中6條航線將由A321XLR執飛部分或全部班次，部分航線則改由777或A330執飛。這波調整配合2026/2027年冬季班表與2027年夏季班表的擴張，A321XLR也將用於新航線的開拓。
international_aviation.headline_en: Air Canada replaces Boeing 787s with Airbus A321XLRs on some routes, redeploying Dreamliners to new long-haul destinations
international_aviation.summary_en: Air Canada will pull the Boeing 787 from 11 routes in the coming months: Calgary–London, Ottawa–London, Montreal–Toulouse, Montreal–Porto, Montreal–Copenhagen, Montreal–Paris, Montreal–Edinburgh, Montreal–Casablanca, Montreal–Berlin, Toronto–Zurich and Toronto–Venice. Six of those services will see the Airbus A321XLR on some or all frequencies, while some routes will instead see the Boeing 777 or Airbus A330. The changes coincide with the airline's planned expansion for the 2026/2027 winter season and the 2027 summer season, and the XLRs were also ordered to further optimize its transatlantic network.
